research_question.title: Structured-group embedding of a coordinate witness prefix
research_question.motivation: A coordinate predicate L(x)=0 does not itself instantiate the structured generic-group model. A recursive F-to-2F-to-4F witness prefix also fails associativity unless all forced regroupings are included. This experiment asks whether a downward-closed formal multiset family can supply a valid EC-compatible partial monoid without exposing the charged final 4F+4F join.

methods: exact pruning on the smallest instances

constraints: The builder may use coordinates and EC arithmetic but not scalar indices or a discrete-log table.
The verifier must independently enumerate the scalar table as toy ground truth.
No direct retained-4F by retained-4F edge appears in the public partial operation; private final-support audit data is charged and separately hashed.
A five-bit implementation/control preflight is not hypothesis evidence for the full 5-12 bit contract.
No result may be described as a faster-than-rho algorithm, relation-rank result, target descent, or deployment break.
research_question.decision_target: Decide whether the builder/verifier and all preregistered controls are sound enough to authorize the complete generated 5-12 bit embedding sweep.
